body:
If you’ve always wanted to attend a top-drawer theological conference (from the comfort of your own home), here’s a great opportunity. The Online and Relational Theology conference will be live Feb 10-11, and audio recordings of all 17 conference sessions will be available for three months after the event. So no need to attend every session discussion.

 Here’s registration information: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/online-international-open-and-relational-theology-conference-tickets-471533167397

 My session will be Saturday afternoon, with three scholars responding to my book “Do I Stay Christian?”

 Friday, February 10

  

 8am Pacific Time: Keith Ward,  Personal Idealism  – Panelists: Tim Miller, Lina Langby, Matt Huffman, Fidel Arnicello – Panel Host: TJO

 9am Pacific: Michael Berra,  Towards a Theology of Relationship  – Panelists: Donn Peters, Ryan Lambros, Natalya Cherry, Michael Lodahl – Panel Host: TJO

 11 am Pacific: John Buchanon,  Processing Reality  – Panelists: Pam Buzalka, Josh Scott, Roger Wolsey, Sheri Kling – Panel Host: JF
